svg.title: The universe teaches itself
svg.desc: A freediver descends a cone of light beneath a sea surface under a starfield, framed by five equations: spacetime, the Schrödinger equation, a cubic learning system, the second law, and the Fourier series. The do-loop at the surface turns, bubbles rise, and sonar rings fall into the deep.
svg.text: The universe teaches itself — no supervision, no menu, no bottom but the one it learns.
